thread:
alex: Quick thought — should our route matcher support boolean-ish expressions on headers? e.g. X-Model-Alias matches 'redwood-prod:*' && X-Tier == 'enterprise'

marta: Today we only support prefix and exact. Expressions would help flexibility but complicate the console and telemetry surfaces.

sam: If we go that way, router must enforce compatibility constraints at match-time. We can't let a pinned model get routed if it lacks required features for the route (like function-calling).

jodi: Agree. For pinning I want a clear fallback chain: route pin -> pinned version -> compatible fallback(s). Console should show the active resolved model and the fallback reason when used.

alex: Sketch of a rule I had in mind:

```json
{
  "match": {
    "path": "/v1/generate",
    "headers": {
      "X-Model-Alias": "redwood-prod:*",
      "X-Tier": "enterprise"
    }
  },
  "policy": {
    "pin": "redwood-prod-v2.4",
    "fallback": ["redwood-prod-v2.3-quant", "redwood-lite"],
    "enforce_route_pin": false
  }
}
```

marta: Telemetry needs to capture per-rule token counts, resolved_model, alias, and an enum for compatibility outcome (ok | missing_feature | runtime_mismatch). That last metric should be an alert trigger.

sam: Implementation detail — add `supported_features` metadata to model manifest. Router runs a compatibility check: required_features subset-of model.supported_features. If check fails, treat as incompatible and try next fallback.

jodi: UX: we also need a gated header override for debugging (devs can force resolved model via header). Must be permissioned and audited.

alex: Edge case: client supplies both X-Model-Alias and X-Model-Version headers. Which wins? Current rule: explicit version header wins. But should we allow a route flag `force_alias_over_version`?

marta: That can be surprising. I'd rather a clear precedence table: explicit version header > route pin (if enforce_route_pin=false then header can override) > alias mapping. Provide explicit toggles per-route for 'enforce_pin' and 'allow_header_override'.

sam: Also: quotas and billing. Quota accounting should be against the final resolved model (so cost attribution is accurate). Telemetry should show both alias and resolved model for audits.

jodi: Action items: I'll draft a short proposal with acceptance criteria: (1) matcher supports prefix/exact + simple header equality + tenant-tier predicate; (2) policy supports pin + ordered fallback + enforce_flag; (3) router does compat check against manifest `supported_features`; (4) telemetry emits alias, resolved_model, compat_reason, quota_bucket. Include unit + e2e test matrix.

alex: Acceptance tests: unit tests for pin + fallback + compat check, e2e that simulates header combinations and shows console displays active pin/fallback reason.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket PLAT-2389 for "routing rule pinning + compatibility" and linked PR #4521.

marta: :thumbsup: I'll own the console mockups for the route editor and the rollout view.

sam: I'll add manifest change and wire compatibility checks into router.

jodi: I'll own the rollout dashboard and alert rule for compatibility regressions.

alex: Great — thanks. Let's sync briefly tomorrow 11:00 to align on API shape and telemetry names.
